title: System Stacking
hook: My morning walk is also my podcast research and my sales call prep. One hour, three jobs done.
statement: One action should serve more than one goal. Stack your goals into the same effort.
explainer: Time is your scarcest resource. When one action hits three goals, you get three results for the price of one. Doing everything separately is the expensive way.
sop: List your top 5 recurring actions and the one goal each serves.
Ask what other goal each could serve with a small tweak.
Compare Goals Served ÷ Actions Taken before and after the redesign.
Redesign the action to hit the extra goals on purpose.
Re-check monthly as your goals shift.
equation_example: One action, 3 Goals Served. 3 ÷ 1 = 3.0. Higher means each action pulls more weight for the same time. A 1.0 means you're spending a separate action on every goal when you could combine them.
question: Pick one thing you do every week and write two more goals it could serve.
closing_statement: One action, one goal is the expensive default.
